name: One product leaks into shared code
problem: One product's prompts and settings creep into shared code, so others have to find and strip them out before they can reuse it.
who_has_it: Teams building AI systems from open-source parts.
why_it_matters: Shared code that carries one product's wording or defaults behaves oddly for other products, and each case has to be found by hand.
why_hard: Product details enter a little at a time, through prompts, defaults and examples, and each looks harmless where it is added.
existing_attempts: Code review, and searching the code for the product's name.
